// purpose: Type-check config for `bun run check` (svelte-check). ui-kit is a raw-source package with no build step, so this tsconfig is the ONLY thing giving its ~86 source files TS coverage — the consuming apps' vite builds strip types without checking, and packages/ui's svelte-check only validates ui-kit's public prop surface at usage sites (review finding on P5a, #555).
// paths: ui-kit source references a small, deliberately app-provided contract via $lib (notifications/theme-state/error-messages — all client-only modules with zero imports of their own). For type-checking we resolve that contract against packages/ui's implementations; every consuming app must supply the same shapes at the same aliases. This is a types-only mapping — no runtime coupling, and the no-app-coupling hygiene test keeps server-assuming modules out of the allowed set. focus-trap (G3, review 2026-07-10) was PROMOTED OUT of this contract into a real kit-internal module (src/lib/actions/focus-trap.ts, exported via the ./actions/* subpath) precisely because an app-provided $lib alias meant packages/client — which has no $lib/actions/focus-trap.js of its own — could never use Drawer.
